top_posts.text:
The biggest issue is scale and shipping economics.
Temu/AliExpress move millions of parcels through consolidated international logistics networks. Your Nigerian quote is for an individual shipment, so you are paying for much more of the logistics chain per parcel.
The solution is consolidation: don't ship individual 1–2 kg parcels directly from Lagos to the US. Use a freight forwarder that consolidates multiple customers' packages into one bulk shipment, then distributes them in the US.
Also, compare door-to-door, air cargo, sea cargo, and consolidated rates separately. A quote of ₦25k/kg with a 10 kg minimum means you're effectively paying at least ₦250k before other possible charges.
top_posts.original_text:
The biggest issue is scale and shipping economics.
Temu/AliExpress move millions of parcels through consolidated international logistics networks. Your Nigerian quote is for an individual shipment, so you are paying for much more of the logistics chain per parcel.
The solution is consolidation: don't ship individual 1–2 kg parcels directly from Lagos to the US. Use a freight forwarder that consolidates multiple customers' packages into one bulk shipment, then distributes them in the US.
Also, compare door-to-door, air cargo, sea cargo, and consolidated rates separately. A quote of ₦25k/kg with a 10 kg minimum means you're effectively paying at least ₦250k before other possible charges.
top_posts.translation_zh:
最大的问题是规模和运输经济性。
Temu/AliExpress 通过整合的国际物流网络运送数百万个包裹。你拿到的尼日利亚报价是针对单个货件的，所以每个包裹要承担物流链中更多环节的成本。
解决办法是集运：不要把 1–2 kg 的单个包裹直接从拉各斯寄到美国。使用货运代理，把多个客户的包裹合并成一票大宗货件，然后在美国境内分发。
另外，把门到门、空运货物、海运货物和集运费率分开比较。₦25k/kg 且最低 10 kg 的报价意味着，在其他可能费用之前，你实际上至少要支付 ₦250k。
